title: Sometimes God pulls you away so He can pull you higher.
paragraphs:
Sometimes God pulls you away so He can pull you higher.
The separation isn’t rejection — it’s preparation.
The isolation isn’t punishment — it’s elevation in disguise.
When God removes you from certain people, places, and patterns…
He’s clearing the runway for your next miracle.
You’re not being set aside… you’re being set apart.

📖 Bible Verse
“Be still, and know that I am God.” – Psalm 46:10
